youtube.title: Napoleon's wallpaper had ARSENIC in it 💚 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon's last room on St Helena was painted with poison 💚

Wallpaper or cancer? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: a scrap of wallpaper from Longwood House, where Napoleon spent his exile, was found to contain arsenic from the fashionable green pigment of the time (Scheele's green). In damp rooms, mould can release arsenic gas, and Longwood was famously damp. It's a theory, not a verdict: his doctors' autopsy blamed stomach cancer, and he died there in 1821.
